series.name: Universal split fault codes (indoor 01-10, outdoor 21-105, HL/CL/Po)
series.notes: LG Air Conditioning Universal Split Fault Codes Sheet (Macedo/Orion, Oct 2010, service manual PDF). LED tens/units scheme. High (official LG service sheet lineage). Covers wall-mount split indoor + outdoor numeric codes.

title.ur: Indoor air sensor khula/short

meaning.en: Return-air thermistor on indoor PCB is open circuit or shorted.
meaning.ur: Indoor PCB ka return-air thermistor open circuit mein hai ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor plug loose or disconnected from indoor PCB
causes.ur: Sensor plug loose ya indoor PCB se disconnect
Thermistor khula/short ho gaya (moisture ya umar se)

causes.en: Wiring harness chafed or rodent damage
causes.ur: Wiring harness ghis gayi ya chuha ne kaata

solutions.en: Power off 5 minutes; reseat sensor connector; retest
solutions.ur: Power 5 minute ke liye band karein; sensor connector sahi se lagayein; dobara check karein

solutions.en: Measure thermistor resistance vs temperature (roughly 10–20 kΩ at room temp) or DC across it; replace if out of curve
solutions.ur: Thermistor ka resistance temperature ke mqable napein (room temperature par taqreeban 10 se 20 kilo-ohm) ya us par DC napein; curve se bahar ho to sensor badal dein

solutions.en: If wiring and sensor OK, inspect indoor PCB connector/solder joints
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek hon to indoor PCB ke connector/solder joints check karein

notes.en: Same meaning as official Africa CH01 sensor page.
notes.ur: Is ka matlab official Africa CH01 sensor page se milta julta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Fascia/remote: code 01 (tens Sleep/Filter, units power LED)

title.ur: Indoor inlet pipe sensor khula/short

meaning.en: Indoor coil inlet pipe thermistor open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil ke inlet pipe ka thermistor khula ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor connector not seated on indoor PCB
causes.ur: Sensor connector indoor PCB par sahi se nahi laga

causes.en: Pipe sensor damaged during installation or coil work
causes.ur: Installation ya coil ke kaam ke doran pipe sensor kharab ho gaya
Sensor tolerance se bahar khula/short

solutions.en: Reseat connector and clear code after power cycle
solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein aur power cycle ke baad code clear karein

solutions.en: Compare resistance to coil-sensor curve (0–70°C scale in sheet); replace if bad
solutions.ur: Resistance ko sheet ka coil-sensor curve (0-70C scale) se compare karein; kharab ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Check kinked or oil-starved liquid line (secondary)
solutions.ur: Peechay muday ya oil se khali liquid line bhi check karein (secondary)

title.ur: Andar ka wired remote se communication fault

meaning.en: Wired remote and indoor unit not exchanging data (common in group control).
meaning.ur: Wired remote aur indoor unit ke darmiyan data ki aamdaad nahi ho rahi (group control mein aam baat hai)

causes.en: Remote back switch left on Single (SG) instead of Group (GR1)
causes.ur: Remote ka peeche wala switch Single (SG) par chhor diya, Group (GR1) par nahi
3-wire remote cable ki wiring galat (12V / GND / signal)
Remote signal line par open/short

solutions.en: Set remote DIP to Group/GR1, power reset 2 minutes
solutions.ur: Remote ka DIP Group/GR1 par set karein, 2 minute power reset karein

solutions.en: Verify red=12V DC, brown/black=0V, yellow=signal fluctuating 8–12V DC
solutions.ur: Check karein: red=12V DC, brown/black=0V, yellow=signal jo 8-12V DC par fluctuate karta ho

solutions.en: Rewire per group-control diagram; remove extra devices on remote bus
solutions.ur: Group-control diagram ke mutabiq wiring dobara karein; remote bus par maujood extra devices nikaal dein

title.ur: Drain pump / float switch — paani high level par

meaning.en: Float switch open (condensate high level) or CN FLOAT jumper missing on units without drain pump; window/portable may show CH04/FL when tank full.
meaning.ur: Float switch khula (condensate high level) ya drain pump wale unit mein CN FLOAT jumper missing; window/portable mein tank bharne par CH04/FL aa sakta hai

causes.en: Blocked drain hose or dirty drain pan
causes.ur: Drain hose block ya drain pan ganda

causes.en: Float stuck or drain pump failed
causes.ur: Float atka hua ya drain pump kharab

causes.en: Missing blue jumper on CN FLOAT (non-pump models) or after PCB swap
causes.ur: CN FLOAT par blue jumper missing (non-pump models) ya PCB badalne ke baad
Zyada humidity (window/portable mein evaporation overload)

solutions.en: Power off, drain condensate (rear drain port/hose), clean pan, reset
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, condensate nikalein (peeche ke drain port/hose se), pan saaf karein aur reset dein

solutions.en: Clear drain line; ensure slope; refit CN FLOAT jumper if missing
solutions.ur: Drain line saaf karein, slope theek karein aur agar CN FLOAT jumper gayab ho to dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Fault appears ~3.5 min after float rises; clear needs power reset (40s lockout)
solutions.ur: Float upar jane ke ~3.5 minute baad fault aata hai; clear karne ke liye power reset chahiye (40s lockout)

notes.en: Official Guide: ceiling types = drain issue; window/portable = tank drain. Alias FL on some firmware.
notes.ur: Official Guide: ceiling types mein drain ka masla, window/portable mein tank drain. Kuch firmware par alias FL hai.

title.ur: Indoor ↔ outdoor communication mein kharabi

meaning.en: Serial communication between indoor and outdoor lost; indoor shows CH05, outdoor PCB shows 53, some remotes show E0. Appears ~5 minutes after power-up.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan serial communication tot gaya; indoor CH05 dikhata hai, outdoor PCB par 53, kuch remotes E0. Power-up ke ~5 minute baad aata hai.

causes.en: Interconnect cable miswired, open, short, or neutral switched
causes.ur: Interconnect cable ki wiring galat, khuli, short ya neutral switched

causes.en: Loose terminals at IDU or ODU terminal block / PCB plugs
causes.ur: IDU ya ODU ke terminal block / PCB plugs par loose terminal

causes.en: Another device (pump, meter) tapped on comms pair
causes.ur: Koi aur device (pump, meter) comms pair par laga ho

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor PCB fault, blown control fuse, EEV/compressor down to earth dragging the bus
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor PCB kharab, control fuse jala hua, ya EEV/compressor earth par short hokar bus ko neeche kheench raha ho
Install/relocation ke baad mains unstable (official)

solutions.en: Power cycle 5 minutes; if fresh install, check piping/wiring with installer
solutions.ur: 5 minute power cycle karein; agar naya install hua ho to installer se piping/wiring check karwaayein

solutions.en: On ODU PCB: green LED = power; red flickering = RX OK; solid red = no RX from IDU; dark = ODU PCB/power fault
solutions.ur: ODU PCB par: green LED = power; red blink = theek; red steady = IDU se signal nahi; dark = ODU PCB/power fault

solutions.en: Measure 0–75 V DC fluctuating on terminals 2–3; isolate wire 3 to split IDU vs ODU side
solutions.ur: Terminals 2-3 par 0-75 V DC fluctuating napein; wire 3 ko alag karke IDU aur ODU side ki alag alag check karein

solutions.en: Before replacing ODU PCB: check fuse cause, fan motors, reversing valve coil, reactor, EEV, compressor to earth
solutions.ur: ODU PCB badalne se pehle fuse ka reason, fan motors, reversing valve coil, reactor, EEV aur compressor ko earth check karein

notes.en: Official Guide groups CH05/E0/CH53. 'EO' on some models = kW Manager, not a fault.
notes.ur: Official Guide CH05/E0/CH53 ko aik hi group ke tor par count karta hai. Kuch models par 'EO' kW Manager hota hai, fault nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: IDU: CH05; ODU LEDs: red 5 blinks / green 3 blinks (code 53)

title.ur: Indoor outlet pipe sensor khula/short

meaning.en: Indoor coil outlet pipe thermistor open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil ke outlet pipe ka thermistor khula ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor plug loose on indoor PCB
causes.ur: Indoor PCB par sensor plug loose
Thermistor kharab
Connector mein zang/nami (monsoon humidity)

solutions.en: Reseat and power cycle
solutions.ur: Dobara lagayein aur power cycle dein

solutions.en: Verify resistance curve; replace sensor
solutions.ur: Resistance curve check karein; sensor badal dein

solutions.en: Inspect indoor PCB socket
solutions.ur: Andar ke PCB socket ko dekhein

title.ur: Alag operation mode (mode conflict)

meaning.en: One or more indoor units set to a mode that conflicts with the master/condenser mode (e.g. heat vs cool).
meaning.ur: Aik ya zyada indoor units aisa mode par hain jo master/condenser mode se takra raha hai (jaise heat vs cool)

causes.en: In multi/2-in-1, a slave set to cooling while master heats (or reverse)
causes.ur: Multi/2-in-1 mein slave cooling par aur master heating par hai (ya iska ulta)

causes.en: Living room cooling, bedroom heating on shared system
causes.ur: Shared system par living room cooling, bedroom heating

causes.en: Master unit switched off so another unit became master with different mode
causes.ur: Master unit band hone se doosra unit master ban gaya jiska mode alag tha

solutions.en: Set all indoor units to same mode (all cool or all heat); fan/purify unrestricted
solutions.ur: Tamam indoor units ko aik hi mode par set karein (sab cool ya sab heat); fan/purify par koi pabandi nahi

solutions.en: Power off at remote, turn on, change mode; clears when modes match
solutions.ur: Remote se power off karein, on karein, mode change karein; modes match hone par code clear ho jata hai

solutions.en: Dehumidify cannot run with heat on same combination
solutions.ur: Isi combination mein heating ke sath dehumidify nahi chal sakta

notes.en: Official Guide full mode matrix for 2-in-1 floor+wall.
notes.ur: Official Guide mein 2-in-1 floor+wall ka poora mode matrix maujood hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Code 07; indoor indicator may blink at 2s intervals (official)

title.ur: EEPROM checksum ka error

meaning.en: EEPROM on indoor PCB reports checksum mismatch — defective PCB or bad EEPROM connection.
meaning.ur: Indoor PCB ka EEPROM checksum mismatch bata raha hai — PCB kharab ya EEPROM connection kharab

causes.en: EEPROM not seated / dry joints on socket
causes.ur: EEPROM sahi se nahi baitha ya socket par dry joints hain
Ghalat PCB assembly laga di gayi

causes.en: EEPROM data corrupted after power surge
causes.ur: Power surge ke baad EEPROM ka data corrupt ho gaya

solutions.en: Check loose connections/dry joints where EEPROM meets main PCB; repair
solutions.ur: Jahan EEPROM main PCB se milta hai wahan loose connection/dry joints check karein; marammat karein

solutions.en: Confirm correct PCB revision; reseat EEPROM
solutions.ur: Sahi PCB revision confirm karein, phir EEPROM dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace PCB if nothing found
solutions.ur: Kuch na mile to PCB badal dein

title.ur: Andar ka BLDC fan motor lock

meaning.en: Indoor fan motor not rotating / rotation not detected — motor or indoor PCB defective.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor ghoom nahi raha ya rotation detect nahi ho rahi — motor ya indoor PCB kharab

causes.en: Fan blade jammed by debris or ice
causes.ur: Gadda ya barf se fan blade jam

causes.en: Hall sensor / feedback circuit fault (fan revs fast then stops)
causes.ur: Hall sensor / feedback circuit kharab (fan tez ghoomne ke baad ruk jata hai)

causes.en: Motor winding open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Motor winding khula/short ya connector loose

causes.en: Indoor PCB not driving 360V DC / 0–5V speed command
causes.ur: Indoor PCB 360V DC / 0-5V speed command nahi de raha

solutions.en: Power off; free the wheel; check windings and PCB output to motor
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, pahiya azad karein, phir windings aur motor ke PCB output check karein

solutions.en: Inspect 5-wire BLDC harness (360V DC, 15V electronics, 0–5V speed) and hall feedback
solutions.ur: 5-wire BLDC harness check karein (360V DC, 15V electronics, 0-5V speed) aur hall feedback dekhein

solutions.en: Replace indoor fan motor or PCB as required (motor+driver often one unit)
solutions.ur: Zaroorat ho to fan motor ya PCB replace karein (motor aur driver aik hi unit hote hain)

notes.en: Official alias E6. Urdu-Hindi YouTube (SUPER REFRIGERATION) corroborates indoor fan/PCB and outdoor temp sensor secondary causes.
notes.ur: Official alias E6 hai. Urdu-Hindi YouTube (SUPER REFRIGERATION) bhi andar ke fan/PCB aur bahar ke temp sensor ko secondary causes batata hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Code 10 (Multi: red 1 flash, green none = CA)

title.ur: Lock lga hua hai (external control)

meaning.en: Unit locked by dry contact or central controller — not an internal fault.
meaning.ur: Unit dry contact ya central controller se band hai — koi andar ka fault nahi

causes.ur: BMS/central controller off ka command bhej raha hai
External dry contact band (closed) hai

solutions.en: Release external lock / check controller schedule
solutions.ur: Bahar ka lock kholein / controller ka schedule check karein

solutions.en: Verify dry-contact wiring
solutions.ur: Dry-contact ki wiring check karein

title.ur: Child lock on

meaning.en: Not an error — child lock feature on.
meaning.ur: Yeh error nahi — child lock feature on hai

causes.en: Timer + Min buttons held 3 seconds accidentally
causes.ur: Ghalti se Timer aur Min buttons 3 second tak pakde rahe

solutions.en: Press Timer and Min together 3 seconds to toggle off
solutions.ur: Timer aur Min ko saath daba kar 3 second tak rakhein, band ho jayega

title.ur: Jet Cool mode faal

meaning.en: Not an error — Jet Cool (rapid cool) mode active.
meaning.ur: Yeh kharabi nahi — Jet Cool (rapid cool) mode chal raha hai.

causes.ur: Jet Cool button dabba diya gaya

solutions.en: Press Jet Cool button to toggle off
solutions.ur: Jet Cool button dabakar band karein

title.ur: IPM mein fault / compressor ka overcurrent (DC peak)

meaning.en: Inverter DC power circuit overcurrent (>14 A DC) — IPM fault, bad inverter PCB, or compressor shorted/to earth.
meaning.ur: Inverter DC power circuit mein zyada current (>14 A DC) — IPM fault, inverter PCB kharab, ya compressor short/earth par.

causes.en: Compressor winding short or insulation breakdown
causes.ur: Compressor winding short ya insulation kharab
Inverter PCB / IPM kharab ho jana
Compressor jam ho kar zyada current le raha hai

solutions.en: Disconnect compressor: U-V, V-W, W-U each 0.25–5 ohm; megger any terminal to earth >2 Mohm
solutions.ur: Compressor alag karein: U-V, V-W, W-U har aik 0.25-5 ohm; kisi bhi terminal ko earth se >2 Mohm megger se check karein

solutions.en: If compressor passes, test inverter output (all 3 phases equal max) or LG inverter tester (all 6 LEDs equal)
solutions.ur: Compressor theek ho to inverter output check karein (teenon phases barabar max) ya LG inverter tester (6 LED barabar)

solutions.en: Replace failed compressor or inverter PCB
solutions.ur: Kharab compressor ya inverter PCB replace karein

notes.en: LG official service video covers CH21 with same checks.
notes.ur: LG ki official service video mein CH21 ke wahi checks diye gaye hain.

title.ur: CT2 mein zyada current

meaning.en: Current transformer 2 sees AC input current above limit (sheet: >14 A).
meaning.ur: Current transformer 2 par AC input current limit se zyada hai (sheet: >14 A).

causes.en: Overloaded system / restricted airflow / EEV issue
causes.ur: System par zyada load, restricted airflow ya EEV masla
Compressor zyada run current le raha hai
Inverter PCB ka current-sense fault

solutions.en: Follow inverter test procedure from sheet; check load conditions
solutions.ur: Sheet ka inverter test procedure follow karein; load conditions check karein

solutions.en: Clear airflow, verify EEV, measure actual run current
solutions.ur: Airflow saaf karein, EEV verify karein aur asli run current naapein

solutions.en: Replace inverter PCB if sense circuit bad
solutions.ur: Sense circuit kharab ho to inverter PCB badal dein

title.ur: DC link ki voltage kam

meaning.en: DC bus to inverter below 140 V DC (should be ~370 V single-phase / ~600 V three-phase).
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage inverter tak 140V se kam gir rahi hai (single-phase ~370V / three-phase ~600V hona chahiye).

causes.en: Inverter charging resistor / precharge circuit fault (often non-replaceable part on PCB)
causes.ur: Inverter charging resistor / precharge circuit kharab (aksar PCB par non-replaceable part)

causes.en: Rectifier or DC bus capacitor failure
causes.ur: Rectifier ya DC bus capacitor kharab

causes.en: Mains too low feeding the drive
causes.ur: Drive ko chalane wala mains voltage bohat kam

solutions.en: Run unit and measure DC at inverter capacitors vs spec
solutions.ur: Unit chala kar inverter capacitors par DC napein aur spec se compare karein

solutions.en: Verify mains voltage under load
solutions.ur: Load ke under mains voltage check karein

solutions.en: Replace outdoor PCB if charging path failed
solutions.ur: Charging path kharab ho to outdoor PCB replace karein

title.ur: Low / high pressure switch khula

meaning.en: LP switch opened (suction <0.5 bar) or HP switch opened (>41 bar); latches after 5 trips in 1 hour.
meaning.ur: LP switch khula (suction <0.5 bar) ya HP switch khula (>41 bar); 1 ghante mein 5 trips par latch ho jata hai

causes.ur: gys km ya lyk ayl py)
Condenser block, non-condensable gas ya zyada charge (HP trip)

causes.en: CN PRESS link missing on boards without pressure switches
causes.ur: Pressure switch na hone wale board par CN PRESS link missing

solutions.en: Power off ODU 2 minutes to clear latch; find why switch tripped
solutions.ur: ODU ko 2 minute band karke latch clear karein; switch kyun trip hua, woh dhoondein

solutions.en: Leak test / correct charge; clean condenser airflow
solutions.ur: Leak test karein / charge theek karein, condenser ki airflow saaf rakhein

solutions.en: Refit CN PRESS link if missing (transfer from old PCB)
solutions.ur: Link gayab ho to wapas laga dein (purane PCB se transfer karein)

notes.en: Distinct from CH38/F4 low-refrigerant soft code.
notes.ur: Yeh CH38/F4 wale low-refrigerant soft code se alag hai.

title.ur: AC input ki voltage kam/zyada

meaning.en: Mains outside 140-300 V AC window.
meaning.ur: Mains voltage 140-300 V AC range se bahar hai

causes.en: Utility brownout or overvoltage (common in PK load-shedding areas)
causes.ur: Utility brownout ya overvoltage (Pakistan ke load-shedding ilaqon mein aam)
Galat supply (phase/neutral) ya choti wiring

causes.en: Outdoor PCB voltage-sense fault if supply is correct
causes.ur: Supply theek ho to outdoor PCB ka voltage-sense fault

solutions.en: Measure L-N under load; correct supply or fit stabilizer within spec
solutions.ur: Load ke under L-N napein; supply theek karein ya spec ke mutabiq stabilizer lagayein

solutions.en: If voltage normal and fault persists, replace ODU PCB
solutions.ur: Voltage normal ho aur fault phir bhi rahe to ODU PCB badal dein

solutions.en: Check breaker and cable size
solutions.ur: Breaker aur cable ka size check karein

title.ur: DC compressor ki position / start fail (jam gaya)

meaning.en: Inverter compressor rotor position not detected or compressor seized — start whine stops after 3 attempts.
meaning.ur: Inverter compressor ki rotor position detect nahi ho rahi ya compressor jam ho gaya — 3 koshishon ke baad start ki awaaz band ho jati hai

causes.ur: Compressor mechanically jam ho gaya
Rotor position sensor ya harness kharab

causes.en: Inverter drive not producing start pattern
causes.ur: Inverter drive start pattern nahi bana raha

solutions.en: Power off 5 minutes; verify compressor connections; restart and listen for start attempt
solutions.ur: 5 minute ke liye bijli band rakhein, compressor ke connections check karein, phir restart karke start ki awaz suniye

solutions.en: If no rotation: test inverter output / replace compressor or ODU PCB
solutions.ur: Rotation na ho to inverter output test karein ya compressor / ODU PCB badal dein

solutions.en: Check for overheating lockout before forcing restart
solutions.ur: Zor se start karne se pehle overheating lockout check karein

title.ur: PSC ka fault — reactor / IGBT overcurrent

meaning.en: Inverter module prospective short-circuit path fault; reactor disconnected or out of spec.
meaning.ur: Inverter module ka short-circuit path fault; reactor disconnect ya spec se bahar

causes.en: Reactor open or loose on PCB
causes.ur: PCB par reactor khula ya loose
IGBT module kharab ho jana
AC-DC converter path par zyada current

solutions.en: Check reactor connected; resistance should be well under 1 ohm
solutions.ur: Reactor ka connection check karein; resistance 1 ohm se kaafi kam honi chahiye

solutions.en: Run inverter test; replace inverter PCB if module bad
solutions.ur: Inverter test karein; module kharab ho to inverter PCB badal dein

solutions.en: Inspect for carbonized IPM terminals (official video flow)
solutions.ur: IPM terminals par karbon ke sur ke nishan dekhein (official video flow)

notes.ur: LG official YouTube par CH21/26/27/29 ka troubleshooting maujood hai.

title.ur: DC link ki voltage zyada

meaning.en: DC bus to inverter too high (Multi sheet: >420 V DC).
meaning.ur: Inverter ka DC bus bohat zyada (Multi sheet: >420 V DC)

causes.ur: Mains overvoltage ya regenerative overshoot

causes.en: DC bus capacitor / discharge path fault
causes.ur: DC bus capacitor ya discharge path kharab hona
Outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Measure DC at capacitors vs 370/600 V spec under run
solutions.ur: Chalte waqt capacitors par DC 370/600 V spec se compare karte hue napein

solutions.en: Verify mains; replace ODU PCB if stable supply yet fault returns
solutions.ur: Mains check karein; supply stable ho aur phir bhi fault aaye to ODU PCB badal dein

solutions.en: Do not keep running — risk to IPM
solutions.ur: Chalna band kar dein — IPM ko khatra hai

title.ur: Inverter compressor mein zyada current (>30 A)

meaning.en: Inverter compressor input current over 30 A.
meaning.ur: Inverter compressor ka input current 30 A se zyada hai.

causes.en: Overload operation: pipe restriction, dirty air, EEV defect, overcharge
causes.ur: Overload chalna: pipe mein rukawat, gandi hawa, EEV kharab, zyada charge
Compressor insulation ya motor kharab
Input voltage kam
ODU ke inverter PCB assembly kharab ho gayi

solutions.en: Correct overload causes (clean coil, open valves, fix EEV, adjust charge)
solutions.ur: Overload ki wajuhat theek karein (coil saaf karein, valves kholein, EEV theek karein, charge adjust karein)

solutions.en: Check input voltage and compressor megger
solutions.ur: Input voltage check karein aur compressor ka megger lein

solutions.en: Replace compressor or inverter PCB
solutions.ur: Compressor ya inverter PCB replace karein

notes.en: Official YouTube covers CH29 with IPM/DC-link checks.
notes.ur: Official YouTube mein CH29 ke IPM/DC-link checks shamil hain.

title.ur: Inverter compressor ka discharge temperature zyada (>105C)

meaning.en: Inverter compressor discharge above 105C — usually low refrigerant or system blockage.
meaning.ur: Inverter compressor discharge 105C se upar — aam tor par refrigerant kam ya system mein blockage

causes.ur: gys km ya lyk

causes.en: Capillary/EEV blockage or filter drier clog
causes.ur: Capillary ya EEV block, ya filter drier clog

causes.en: Poor condenser airflow raising head pressure and superheat
causes.ur: Condenser airflow kharab hone se head pressure aur superheat barha

solutions.en: Power reset 2 min; if runs, discharge should stay ~50C above ambient — watch until stable
solutions.ur: 2 minute power reset karein; chalne par discharge ambient se ~50C upar tikau rahe — stable hone tak nazar rakhein

solutions.en: Leak search, correct charge, verify EEV/filters
solutions.ur: Leak dhoondein, charge theek karein, EEV/filters check karein

solutions.en: Do not long-run while hot — compressor damage risk
solutions.ur: Garam haalat mein lamba na chalayein — compressor kharab hone ka khatra

notes.en: LG Africa official groups CH32/33/36/38/F4 as refrigerant-family codes.
notes.ur: LG Africa official CH32/33/36/38/F4 ko refrigerant-family codes ke tor par group karta hai.

title.ur: Constant-speed compressor ka discharge temperature zyada (>105C)

meaning.en: Fixed-speed compressor discharge over 105C — low gas or blockage.
meaning.ur: Fixed-speed compressor ka discharge 105C se upar — gas kam ya blockage

causes.ur: gys km/lyk
System mein restriction
Condenser ganda ya ambient temperature zyada

solutions.en: Reset 2 min; verify discharge vs ambient rule of thumb
solutions.ur: 2 minute ka reset dein, phir discharge vs ambient ko rule of thumb se verify karein

solutions.en: Correct charge and airflow
solutions.ur: Charge aur airflow theek karein

solutions.en: Technician leak/blockage diagnosis
solutions.ur: Technician se leak/blockage diagnosis karwaayein

title.en: PFC communication error (PFC to inverter PCB)
title.ur: PFC communication mein kharabi (PFC se inverter PCB)

meaning.en: Communication lost between PFC board and inverter PCB.
meaning.ur: PFC board aur inverter PCB ke beech communication toot gaya hai

causes.ur: PCB kharab ya wiring kharab
Micom ke software versions ek jaise nahi hain
ODU ka inverter PCB assembly kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Check/repair wiring between boards
solutions.ur: Boards ke darmiyan wiring check/marammat karein

solutions.en: Confirm matching software versions
solutions.ur: Ke software versions ek jaise hain yeh confirm karein

solutions.en: Replace ODU inverter PCB if fault remains
solutions.ur: Fault baqi rahe to ODU inverter PCB replace karein

title.ur: CT circuit mein kharabi

meaning.en: Current transformer circuit in inverter AC path faulty.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke AC path ka current transformer circuit kharab

causes.en: CT sensing circuit open/short on inverter PCB
causes.ur: Inverter PCB par CT sensing circuit khula/short
CT ki wiring harness masla
PCB assembly kharab

solutions.en: Refer to inverter testing procedure at end of sheet
solutions.ur: Sheet ke aakhir mein di gayi inverter testing procedure dekhein

solutions.en: Inspect CT connections on outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB par CT connections check karein

solutions.en: Replace outdoor PCB if CT path failed
solutions.ur: CT path kharab ho to outdoor PCB replace karein

title.en: Inverter compressor discharge pipe sensor open/short
title.ur: Inverter compressor ke discharge pipe sensor ka open/short

meaning.en: Discharge pipe thermistor on inverter compressor open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Inverter compressor ke discharge pipe ka thermistor khula ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor plug loose or thermistor failed
causes.ur: Sensor plug loose ya thermistor kharab

causes.en: Harness damaged by heat at discharge line
causes.ur: Discharge line ke paas harness garmi se kharab
Indoor/outdoor PCB connector kharab

solutions.en: Compare resistance to discharge-sensor curve (20-110C scale); replace if bad
solutions.ur: Resistance ko discharge-sensor curve (20-110C scale) se compare karein; kharab ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Reseat connector; repair harness
solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein, harness ki marammat karein

solutions.en: Check PCB socket if sensor good
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi ho to PCB socket check karein

title.ur: Outdoor air sensor khula/short

meaning.en: Outdoor ambient air thermistor open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient air thermistor khula ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor plug loose on outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par sensor plug loose
Thermistor kharab (dhoop/garmi se aging)
Chuha ne harness kaata

solutions.en: Reseat; measure resistance vs ambient curve; replace sensor
solutions.ur: Dobara lagayein; ambient curve ke mqable resistance napein; sensor badal dein

solutions.en: Inspect outdoor PCB connector
solutions.ur: Bahar ke PCB connector ko dekhein

solutions.en: Repair harness damage
solutions.ur: Harness ki marammat karein

notes.en: Official Africa page groups CH44 with outdoor sensors.
notes.ur: Official Africa page CH44 ko bahar ke sensors ke sath group karta hai.

title.en: Outdoor condenser coil pipe sensor open/short
title.ur: Bahar ke condenser coil pipe sensor ka open/short

meaning.en: Condenser coil (middle/outlet) thermistor open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Condenser coil (middle/outlet) ka thermistor khula ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or thermistor failed
causes.ur: Sensor connector loose ya thermistor kharab
Coil ki safai ke doran sensor kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Reseat and verify against coil curve; replace if needed
solutions.ur: Dobara lagayein aur coil curve se verify karein; zaroorat ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Check outdoor PCB socket
solutions.ur: Bahar ke PCB socket ko check karein

solutions.en: Careful coil wash to avoid sensor breakage
solutions.ur: Coil dhote waqt ehtiyat karein taake sensor na toote

title.ur: Outdoor suction pipe sensor khula/short

meaning.en: Compressor suction line thermistor open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Compressor suction line ka thermistor khula ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor plug loose or thermistor failed
causes.ur: Sensor plug loose ya thermistor kharab
Suction line par harness kharab

solutions.en: Reseat; measure resistance; replace sensor if out of curve
solutions.ur: Dobara lagayein; resistance napein; curve se bahar ho to sensor badal dein

solutions.en: Inspect PCB connector and harness routing
solutions.ur: PCB connector aur harness ki routing check karein

solutions.en: Verify readings vs actual line temperature after repair
solutions.ur: Marammat ke baad readings ko asli line temperature se compare karein

title.ur: Constant-speed compressor ke discharge sensor ka open/short

meaning.en: Discharge pipe thermistor for constant-speed compressor open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Constant-speed compressor ka discharge pipe thermistor khula ya short ho gaya hai

causes.ur: Sensor kharab ya plug loose
Discharge par garmi se harness kharab

solutions.en: Test against discharge curve; replace sensor
solutions.ur: Discharge curve ke against test karein; sensor badal dein

solutions.en: Reseat connector; repair harness
solutions.ur: Connector ko dobara lagayein aur harness theek karein

solutions.en: Confirm PCB socket
solutions.ur: PCB socket ko confirm karein

title.en: Discharge and air sensor both open (dual sensor unplugged)
title.ur: Discharge aur air sensor dono khule (dual sensor ka plug nahi)

meaning.en: Discharge sensor and outdoor air sensor share one connector; both reading open = plug not seated. On Multi V, may mean outdoor coil sensor fault instead.
meaning.ur: Discharge sensor aur outdoor air sensor aik hi connector par hain; dono ka reading khula ho to matlab plug sahi se nahi laga. Multi V par iska matlab outdoor coil sensor fault bhi ho sakta hai

causes.en: Shared CN plug unplugged after service
causes.ur: Service ke baad shared CN plug nikal diya
Connector ka latch toota hua
Dono sensors aik hi waqt khule (kam hota hai)

solutions.en: Plug the dual-sensor connector back into outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Dual-sensor connector ko outdoor PCB par wapas laga dein

solutions.en: Inspect connector for damage; replace harness
solutions.ur: Connector kharab hai ya nahi dekhein; harness badal dein

solutions.en: If code persists, test each sensor separately
solutions.ur: Code phir bhi rahe to har sensor ko alag alag test karein

notes.en: Ample Air notes Multi V meaning as outdoor coil sensor — same code number, product-dependent meaning.
notes.ur: Ample Air ke according Multi V mein isi code ka matlab bahar ka coil sensor hai — code number wahi, matlab product par depend karta hai.

title.ur: Capacity se zyada ka combination

meaning.en: Connected indoor units total capacity exceeds outdoor unit allowance.
meaning.ur: Lagaye hue indoor units ki kul capacity outdoor unit ki allowance se zyada hai

causes.en: Wrong IDU/ODU match after renovation or spare parts swap
causes.ur: Renovation ya spare parts badalne ke baad galat IDU/ODU match
Multi split mein zyada branches lage hue hain

causes.en: Sub ODU dip-switch settings wrong (VRF-adjacent installs)
causes.ur: Sub ODU ki dip-switch settings galat (VRF-adjacent installs)

solutions.en: List model numbers of all IDUs and ODU; verify combination chart
solutions.ur: Tamam IDUs aur ODU ke model numbers likhein aur combination chart se verify karein

solutions.en: Remove excess indoor units or fit correctly rated ODU
solutions.ur: Zaroorat se zyada indoor units hata dein ya sahi rating wala ODU lagayein

solutions.en: Correct dip switches if applicable
solutions.ur: Mumkin ho to dip switches theek karein

title.en: Main micom to sub micom communication error
title.ur: Main micom aur sub micom ka communication error

meaning.en: Communication lost between main and sub CPUs on outdoor main PCB.
meaning.ur: Outdoor main PCB par main aur sub CPUs ke beech communication toot gaya hai

causes.ur: PCB kharab ho gaya ya wiring kharab
Micoms ke darmiyan firmware/version mismatch
Power supply glitch se bus corrupt

solutions.en: Reset power; if code returns replace outdoor main PCB
solutions.ur: Power reset karein; code wapas aaye to outdoor main PCB replace karein

solutions.en: Look for burn marks / damaged traces before replacing
solutions.ur: Badalne se pehle jalne ya tootne ke nishan dekhein

solutions.en: Confirm correct PCB assembly
solutions.ur: Sahi PCB assembly ki tasdeeq karein

title.en: Indoor to outdoor communication error (ODU side)
title.ur: Indoor se outdoor communication error (ODU side)

meaning.en: Outdoor unit reports lost serial link to indoor — same physical fault as CH05, displayed as 53 on outdoor PCB.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ko indoor se serial link toota hua mehsoos hota hai — CH05 jaisi hi physical fault, outdoor PCB par 53 dikhta hai

causes.en: Same as CH05: cable, terminals, PCB, or earth leakage on bus
causes.ur: CH05 jaisi hi: cable, terminal, PCB, ya bus par earth leakage

causes.en: IDU not powered while ODU is
causes.ur: ODU on hai magar IDU band hai
Dobara wiring karne ke baad interconnect polarity/terminals galat

solutions.en: Diagnose as CH05 (see code 05)
solutions.ur: CH05 ki tarah diagnose karein (code 05 dekhein)

solutions.en: Confirm both units energized and comms wire on correct terminals
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke dono units on hain aur comms wire sahi terminals par hai

solutions.en: Measure 0-75 V DC fluctuating on outdoor terminals 2-3
solutions.ur: Outdoor terminals 2-3 par 0-75 V DC fluctuating napein

notes.en: Multi sheet: CH05 indoor / 53 outdoor for same fault.
notes.ur: Multi sheet mein isi fault ke liye CH05 andar aur 53 bahar liya jata hai.

title.ur: 3-phase reverse ya missing phase

meaning.en: Outdoor 3-phase supply has a phase missing or phases reversed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor 3-phase supply mein koi phase missing hai ya phases reverse hain

causes.en: Utility phase lost or wrong phase rotation after wiring work
causes.ur: Wiring kaam ke baad utility ka phase gaya ya phase sequence galat
Phase terminal loose
Breaker ka pole theek se contact nahi banata

solutions.en: Check ~415V AC across red-blue, blue-yellow, red-yellow
solutions.ur: Red-blue, blue-yellow aur red-yellow par ~415V AC napein

solutions.en: If all present but reverse: power off, swap red and yellow cores, reset
solutions.ur: Agar sab maujood hon lekin reverse hon: power off karein, red aur yellow cores ki sarpak badlein, reset karein

solutions.en: Inform electrician if supply side phase wrong
solutions.ur: Supply side par phase galat ho to electrician ko bataayein

notes.en: Official Guide: may appear after outage or electrical work; does not self-clear without power cycle.
notes.ur: Official Guide: bijli band hone ya electrical kaam ke baad aa sakta hai; power cycle kiye baghair khud clear nahi hota.

title.ur: Bahar ke PCB EEPROM ka checksum match nahi

meaning.en: Outdoor unit PCB EEPROM data checksum failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit PCB ke EEPROM ka data checksum fail ho gaya

causes.ur: Ghalat PCB assembly laga diya gaya
EEPROM socket par dry solder joints hain
Surge se EEPROM corrupt

solutions.en: Confirm correct PCB; reseat EEPROM; check dry joints
solutions.ur: Sahi PCB confirm karein, EEPROM dobara lagayein aur dry joints check karein

solutions.en: Replace outdoor PCB if nothing found
solutions.ur: Kuch na mile to outdoor PCB badal dein

solutions.en: Investigate surge protection if recurring
solutions.ur: Baar bar aaye to surge protection check karein

title.en: High temperature protection (condenser coil high / overheat)
title.ur: Zyada temperature se protection (condenser coil high / overheat)

meaning.en: Cooling: outdoor condenser coil temperature high (sheet >65C). Heating: indoor overheat (official). May display as P4/P6/P7/P8/CH34 on some models.
meaning.ur: Cooling mein: outdoor condenser coil temperature zyada (sheet >65C). Heating mein: indoor overheat (official). Kuch models par P4/P6/P7/P8/CH34 bhi dikhta hai

causes.en: Blocked outdoor coil (bags, dirt) or recirculating hot air
causes.ur: Outdoor coil par blockage (kura, gand) ya garam hawa wapas ghoom rahi hai

causes.en: Enclosed balcony / no ventilation window / air guide missing
causes.ur: Band balcony / ventilation window nahi / air guide gayab

causes.en: Dirty indoor filter causing poor heat-mode airflow (heating case)
causes.ur: Heating mein gande indoor filter ki wajah se airflow kam
System mein nitrogen ya non-condensable gas

solutions.en: Clear space around ODU; open ventilation window; add air guide (LG: ~6-8C drop)
solutions.ur: ODU ke aas paas jagah khali karein; ventilation window kholein; air guide lagayein (LG: ~6-8C farq)

solutions.en: Clean outdoor coil and indoor filter
solutions.ur: Bahar ka coil aur andar ka filter saaf karein

solutions.en: Power cycle to clear (does not auto-clear per official); if persists call technician
solutions.ur: Clear karne ke liye power cycle karein (official ke mutabiq khud clear nahi hota); phir bhi rahe to technician bulayein

notes.en: Official Guide adds heating-mode indoor overheat interpretation and alias list.
notes.ur: Official Guide heating-mode mein andar ke overheat ka matlab aur alias ki list bhi add karta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: ODU red 6x / green 1x; remote may show CH61 or P4/P6/P7/P8/CH34

title.ur: Inverter heat sink zyada garm (>85C)

meaning.en: Outdoor inverter heat-sink thermistor measured over 85C; unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: Outdoor inverter ke heat-sink thermistor ki reading 85C se upar; unit band ho jata hai

causes.ur: Heat-sink fins par gadda/blockage
Heat-sink ka thermistor error (code 65 dekhein)

causes.en: Inverter cooling fan failure on Multi V style units
causes.ur: Multi V jaise units mein inverter cooling fan kharab
Lamba waqt tak zyada load ya zyada ambient temperature

solutions.en: Power off; clean heat sink and outdoor coil
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, heat sink aur bahar ka coil saaf karein

solutions.en: Verify heat-sink fan running; test thermistor (code 65)
solutions.ur: Heat-sink wala fan chal raha hai yeh verify karein, thermistor test karein (code 65)

solutions.en: Do not keep running hot — stop and service
solutions.ur: Garam chalate rahe band na karein — rok kar service karwaayein

title.en: Condenser coil pipe temperature too low
title.ur: Condenser coil pipe ka temperature bahut kam

meaning.en: Condenser coil pipe thermistor reading abnormally low (possible sensor fault or freeze condition).
meaning.ur: Condenser coil pipe ka thermistor bohat kam reading de raha hai (sensor fault ya jam/freeze ho sakta hai)

causes.ur: Thermistor khula, reading kam / kharab

causes.en: Low ambient / unit running in extreme cold without control
causes.ur: Kam ambient / bahut sardi mein bina control ke chalna
Refrigerant distribution masla

solutions.en: Test condenser pipe thermistor; replace if bad
solutions.ur: Condenser pipe sensor test karein; kharab ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Check operating mode and ambient; correct charge if liquid floodback suspected
solutions.ur: Operating mode aur ambient check karein; liquid floodback ka shak ho to charge theek karein

solutions.en: Inspect PCB input if sensor OK
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi ho to PCB input check karein

title.ur: Heat sink thermistor khula/short

meaning.en: Inverter PCB heat-sink thermistor open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Inverter PCB ke heat-sink ka thermistor khula ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor plug loose on outdoor inverter PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor inverter PCB par sensor plug loose
Thermistor kharab
Garmi se connector kharab

solutions.en: Reseat; measure resistance vs ambient curve; replace sensor
solutions.ur: Dobara lagayein; ambient curve ke mqable resistance napein; zaroorat ho to sensor replace karein

solutions.en: Check PCB socket and harness
solutions.ur: PCB socket aur harness check karein

solutions.en: Clean heat sink while servicing
solutions.ur: sros ke sath hyt snk saf kary

title.ur: Bahar ka BLDC fan motor lock

meaning.en: Outdoor fan rotation not detected — fan motor or drive circuit problem.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan ki rotation detect nahi ho rahi — fan motor ya drive circuit masla

causes.en: Fan seized by debris or bearing failure
causes.ur: Gadda se fan jam ya bearing kharab

causes.en: Hall sensor / feedback fault (fast spin then stop)
causes.ur: Hall sensor / feedback kharab (tez ghoomne ke baad ruk jata hai)

causes.en: Motor winding open/short or PCB drive failure
causes.ur: Motor winding open/short ya PCB drive kharab

solutions.en: Power off; free outdoor fan; check windings and PCB output
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, bahar ka fan azad karein, phir windings aur PCB output check karein

solutions.en: Check 5-wire DC fan harness and hall feedback (~12V feed)
solutions.ur: 5-tear wala DC fan harness aur hall feedback (~12V feed) check karein

solutions.en: Replace outdoor fan motor (driver integrated) or PCB
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor (driver integrated) ya PCB replace karein

notes.en: Official alias EF; CH67/EF grouped as outdoor fan in official Guide.
notes.ur: Official alias EF hai; official Guide mein CH67/EF ko bahar ke fan ke tor par group kiya gaya hai.

title.ur: PFC ka fault (software) mein overcurrent peak

meaning.en: Inverter PCB input current over 48 A peak for 2 ms (PFC software protection).
meaning.ur: Inverter PCB ka input current 2 millisecond ke liye 48 A peak se upar gaya (PFC software protection)

causes.en: Overload operation: pipe restriction, restricted airflow, EEV defect, overcharge
causes.ur: Overload chalna: pipe mein rukawat, airflow kam, EEV kharab, zyada charge
Compressor insulation ya motor kharab

causes.en: Input voltage abnormal or power wiring abnormal
causes.ur: Input voltage ya power wiring galat
Inverter PCB assembly kharab ho gayi

solutions.en: Clear overload causes; verify mains and wiring
solutions.ur: Overload ki wajuhat theek karein; mains aur wiring check karein

solutions.en: Compressor insulation and inverter tests
solutions.ur: Compressor ki insulation aur inverter ke tests karein

solutions.en: Replace inverter PCB if fault remains
solutions.ur: Fault baqi rahe to inverter PCB replace karein

title.en: Main outdoor PCB to fan PCB communication error
title.ur: Main outdoor PCB aur fan PCB ka communication error

meaning.en: Communication lost between outdoor main PCB and outdoor fan PCB.
meaning.ur: Outdoor main PCB aur outdoor fan PCB ke beech communication toot gaya hai

causes.en: Open/short of communication line between main and fan PCBs
causes.ur: Main aur fan PCBs ke beech communication line khula/short
Communication cable ka plug loose

causes.en: Fan PCB not powered / communication LED off
causes.ur: Fan PCB bijli par nahi / communication LED band

solutions.en: Check open/short on comm line between boards
solutions.ur: Boards ke beech communication line par open/short check karein

solutions.en: Reseat communication cable plugs; confirm comm LED
solutions.ur: Communication cable ke plugs dobara lagayein, comm LED confirm karein

solutions.en: Replace fan PCB or main PCB after isolation
solutions.ur: Alag karke fan PCB ya main PCB replace karein

notes.en: Ample Air CH105/108 duplicate claims quarantined as VRF; this Universal definition is authoritative for splits.
notes.ur: Ample Air ki CH105/108 wali duplicate claims ko VRF ke tor par quarantine kiya gaya hai; splits ke liye yeh Universal definition authoritative hai.

codes.blinkPattern: ODU red 6x / green 5x (per outdoor LED map for 105)
